name: Tasklark
summary: A seven-page project management dashboard with sprint board, timeline, task list and team load
about: A seven-page project management app for a small product team, with a sprint burndown, a drag-and-drop board, a timeline with dependency arrows, a bulk-edit task list and a team workload view. Good for team workspaces, SaaS product teams, agencies and client portals.
how: Overview shows the sprint burndown in a gradient hero card, your own tasks, project health rings and team activity. Tick a task to finish it.
On Board, drag a task to another column or use its ⋯ menu. Drop one on Done for a confetti burst. Type in a column footer to add a task fast.
On Timeline, drag a bar to move it, drag its right edge to resize, or drag a project bar to shift all its tasks. Arrow keys work on a focused bar.
On Tasks, search, filter, sort and page through every task, tick rows and mark them done, reassign or delete them together.
On Team, drag a task chip onto another person to hand it over and watch both capacity bars change.
Click any task for its drawer: fields, subtasks, files and comments. Settings has members, sprint length, notifications, theme and Reset demo data.
